title: Design and Implement Landing Page UI
description: Create a responsive, accessible landing page for Webpage Analyzer that introduces the product and prompts users to sign up or log in via Clerk authentication.
details:
- Use Next.js 14 (App Router) and React 18 for page structure.
- Style with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, and Lucide icons for visual appeal.
- Ensure the landing page is mobile-first, responsive, and meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
- Include a clear call-to-action (CTA) for sign-up/login, leveraging Clerk authentication widgets.
- Add brief marketing copy describing the product’s value proposition.
- Integrate Framer Motion for subtle entrance animations.
- Ensure the landing page is the default route and redirects authenticated users to the analyzer page.
- Sanitize and optimize all static content for performance (≤2s load at 3G speeds).
test_strategy:
- Manually verify landing page renders correctly on desktop and mobile devices.
- Use Lighthouse to check accessibility and performance scores.
- Confirm Clerk widgets display and function as expected.
- Test responsive breakpoints and visual consistency across browsers.
- Validate that authenticated users are redirected appropriately.
